reading:
THE ρ=0 END OF THE REGRESSION. This is the 9 June capture whose 30 July counterpart returns Mary Lee the great white shark and two Sale Sharks rugby players. Here, six of six cards are authored surfaces and the composed answer is accurate: Detroit-area independent scholar, comparative literature PhD, teacher.

Two details only reading finds. Card 5 describes the subject as a PERSONA — "the primary author persona within the Crimson Hexagon, holding three operational mantles that function as translation attractors" — so the heteronymic architecture is served as the answer to a biographical question. And card 6's snippet is not the author's text at all but a READER'S COMMENT on a Medium post ("Lee, this is a genuinely fascinating formalization…"), a third party's praise surfaced as a source about the person.

The operator's own margin note closes the paste: "they're just *so* weird - they're all off in different ways and bizarrely wonderful in others."
